Game Overview

At its heart, Jack Blast is a halloween game about guide Jack the pumpkin through a spooky landscape using explosive blasts. Master the art of timing and precision to dodge perilous spikes and reach safety. With increasingly challenging levels and a haunting atmosphere, can you help Jack escape with perfect three-star ratings in this thrilling Halloween adventure?
